propositions: Extract jscpd invocation and JSON statistics parsing into a shared run_jscpd helper in analyzers/_jscpd.py to eliminate invocation drift between backfill script and new adapter.
New jscpd_dup.py adapter must parse statistics.total.clones (int) and statistics.total.percentage (float) from jscpd JSON report and return AnalyzerResult.duplication.
When jscpd binary is absent, the adapter must return Unavailable(reason, _ACCRUING_SINCE) rather than raising or returning zeros.
Backfill script must continue using bare jscpd invocation (no npx) and delegate to the shared run_jscpd runner without behavioral change.
Prove single shared runner reuse, exact clone/percentage parsing, graceful absence handling, and unchanged backfill invocation via unit contract tests with stateful CLI fake.
